title: Find Missing Elements
summary: Given an array of unique integers, find and return a sorted list of all missing integers within the original range, which includes the smallest and largest integers present in the array.
statement: Given an array of unique integers, find and return a sorted list of all missing integers within the original range, which includes the smallest and largest integers present in the array. If no integers are missing, return an empty list.
constraints: Within the inclusive range from its minimum to maximum, return every absent integer.
hints: Enumerate every integer from minimum through maximum inclusive.
Retain values not found in the set.
Increasing range enumeration gives the required sorted order.
editorial: Increasing range enumeration gives the required sorted order.

tests.explanation: The range one through five contains only missing value three.
Every integer in the range is present, so return an empty list.
